sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自纽约时报，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: Today, Rabbit Hole.
sentences.zh: 今天是《兔子洞》。

sentences.en: Episode 6.
sentences.zh: 第六集。

sentences.en: My name is Brad.
sentences.zh: 我叫布拉德。

sentences.en: How did you become the biggest star?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么成为最大牌的明星的？

sentences.en: Hey, man, congrats on your journalism job.
sentences.zh: 嘿，兄弟，恭喜你找到新闻工作。

sentences.en: Oh, my God, our kids are listening to Elvis.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪，我们的孩子在听猫王。

sentences.en: We need to keep fighting back.
sentences.zh: 我们需要继续反击。

sentences.en: The diamond stormed in.
sentences.zh: 钻石冲了进来。

sentences.en: Subscribe to YouTube.
sentences.zh: 订阅YouTube。

sentences.en: So it's been a while since you did one of these, huh?
sentences.zh: 所以你做这种采访已经有一段时间了吧？

sentences.en: It's been a while.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间了。

sentences.en: It's been a long time.
sentences.zh: 好久没做了。

sentences.en: How long?
sentences.zh: 多久了？

sentences.en: Probably two years, maybe.
sentences.zh: 大概两年吧。

sentences.en: That's interesting.
sentences.zh: 真有意思。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So Felix decides to sit down and talk with you for his first interview since the whole Wall Street Journal controversy.
sentences.zh: 所以菲利克斯决定坐下来接受你的采访，这是他自从《华尔街日报》风波以来的首次采访。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I was curious, first of all, like just why he was doing this, like why he was sitting down with someone from the mainstream media after so long.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，首先，他为什么这么做，为什么时隔这么久愿意坐下来接受主流媒体的采访。

sentences.en: I was surprised because, you know, I've been like, I've been asking for like two years.
sentences.zh: 我很惊讶，因为你知道，我其实已经求了两年了。

sentences.en: I mean, it's like, here we are.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你看，我们就这样开始了。

sentences.en: And also like after following his career for so long and just seeing everything that's happened, I just wanted to know what he made of it all.
sentences.zh: 而且在关注他的职业生涯这么久、看到发生的所有事情之后，我只是想知道他是怎么看待这一切的。

sentences.en: I was actually like, in preparing for this, going back and looking at some of your old, your old videos, like old, old, old videos.
sentences.zh: 其实在准备这次采访时，我回去看了一些你以前的、以前的视频，真的很老很老的视频。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Like sort of Minecraft days.
sentences.zh: 有点像《我的世界》时期的那种。

sentences.en: Do you remember feeling sort of happy during that time?
sentences.zh: 你还记得那时候感觉挺开心的吗？

sentences.en: Like, was that a good time in your life?
sentences.zh: 比如，那算你人生中一段美好的时光吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think so.
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得是的。

sentences.en: I think things were going pretty well.
sentences.zh: 我觉得当时一切都挺顺利的。

sentences.en: Things were going great.
sentences.zh: 一切都进展得很好。

sentences.en: Watched more than I ever expected.
sentences.zh: 观看量超出了我的预期。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: And then like 2015 and into 2016, I think there was sort of this larger cultural thing happening
sentences.zh: 然后大约在2015年到2016年期间，我觉得发生了一些更宏大的文化现象

sentences.en: where like the line between the internet and the like real world was sort of starting to break down.
sentences.zh: 互联网和现实世界之间的界限开始逐渐模糊。

sentences.en: People started paying more attention to what's happening on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 人们开始更多地关注YouTube上发生的事情。

sentences.en: Do you feel like, I sort of remember from that time that things were starting to get a little edgier.
sentences.zh: 你觉得，我隐约记得从那个时候开始，事情变得有点出格了。

sentences.en: Like there was sort of more incentives to try out edgier stuff.
sentences.zh: 好像有更多尝试出格内容的动力。

sentences.en: I think YouTube at that time was at a place where no one really knew where the limit was.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那时的YouTube正处于一个没有人真正知道底线在哪里的阶段。

sentences.en: And I think that's why it almost became, yeah, a lot of channels just pushing it as far as possible because there was no restrictions at the time, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是为什么它几乎变成了，对，很多频道把底线推得越来越远，因为当时没有什么限制，我是这么觉得的。

sentences.en: And I think also my channel went through this.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得我的频道也经历了这一过程。

sentences.en: I didn't only want it to be associated with kid humor, even though edgy humor is a lot of childish, but I think it's more stepping up to teen humor.
sentences.zh: 我不仅希望它只和儿童幽默联系在一起，尽管出格幽默有很多幼稚成分，但我觉得它更像是向青少年幽默迈进了一步。

sentences.en: Do you feel like you recognized that there was a risk in getting sort of more into that space?
sentences.zh: 你觉得当时你意识到进入那个领域是有风险的吗？

sentences.en: That there could be like a backlash?
sentences.zh: 可能会引起某种强烈反弹？

sentences.en: I think I was really not focused on that at all in retrospect.
sentences.zh: 回想起来，我当时真的完全没有关注这一点。

sentences.en: I was pretty, I'll start my word, irresponsible about it.
sentences.zh: 我当时相当……恕我直言，对此很不负责任。

sentences.en: I don't think I really looked at too much of the consequences.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我当时并没有太考虑后果。

sentences.en: Do you remember like getting pushed back from anyone in your life that was like before the journal article?
sentences.zh: 在你生活中有没有谁在文章出来之前给过你阻力？

sentences.en: Well, I kind of wish I had some.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我倒有点希望当时有人这么做。

sentences.en: Clearly I didn't.
sentences.zh: 显然没有。

sentences.en: But fans were just into it and they thought about it.
sentences.zh: 但粉丝们很喜欢，他们也对此有所思考。

sentences.en: I think, yeah, everyone, it's when you're in this space where people understand that it's a joke,
sentences.zh: 我想，对，每个人，当你在这样一个大家都能明白这只是个玩笑的圈子里时，

sentences.en: you're in this area where everyone is on the same page.
sentences.zh: 你就处在一个所有人都心领神会的领域。

sentences.en: It's not really, no, I don't remember having that being.
sentences.zh: 并不是真的，不，我不记得有过这种感觉。

sentences.en: And was that how you sort of viewed like that period?
sentences.zh: 你当时就是这样看待那段时期的吗？

sentences.en: It was just people joking and being sort of stuff that might look serious if you look back at it today, but at the time it was just all joking?
sentences.zh: 就觉得大家只是在开玩笑，做一些现在回头看可能显得很严肃的事情，但当时纯粹都是玩笑？

sentences.en: Yes, I think so.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想是的。

sentences.en: Was there ever something that you like stopped yourself because you were like, oh, that's too edgy?
sentences.zh: 有没有那么一刻，你停下来制止自己，心想：哦，这太出格了？

sentences.en: Uh, well, definitely the infamous sign.
sentences.zh: 呃，当然有，那个声名狼藉的牌子。

sentences.en: As Felix and I were talking, it became clear pretty quickly that like the things that he was doing in his videos, these kind of like edgy experimental things.
sentences.zh: 我和菲利克斯交谈时，很快就清楚了，他在视频里做的事情，这些有点出格的实验性内容，

sentences.en: The goal isn't to purposely push too much or makes people feel bad.
sentences.zh: 其目的并不是故意太过火或者让人感觉不好。

sentences.en: Including this Fiverr video with the death tall juice sign.
sentences.zh: 包括那个写着“犹太人去死”牌子的Fiverr视频。

sentences.en: They all felt pretty low risk to him.
sentences.zh: 对当时的税而言，这些都属于低风险。

sentences.en: And how do you draw that line?
sentences.zh: 那你又是怎么划定这条线的呢？

sentences.en: Like, how did you decide what was too edgy and what was just edgy enough?
sentences.zh: 比如，你是怎么决定什么叫太出格，什么又叫恰到好处的？

sentences.en: Um, that's a good question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个好问题。

sentences.en: Just kind of like...
sentences.zh: 差不多就是……

sentences.en: I mean, anything that would, I mean, the way me and my editors work is that we kind of go uncensored
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，任何会……我和我的剪辑师的工作方式是，我们先进行无删减的拍摄，

sentences.en: and then in the edit we'll definitely cut out most of the edgy jokes or whatever.
sentences.zh: 然后在剪辑时一定会剪掉大部分出格的笑话或者别的什么。

sentences.en: If we recognize that someone might get offended or hurt by it, then there's no reason to intentionally put it in.
sentences.zh: 如果我们意识到有人可能会被其冒犯或伤害，那就没有理由故意把它放进去。

sentences.en: I think that's the way we looked at it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们就是这样看待它的。

sentences.en: You ready to go to the Wall Street Journal?
sentences.zh: 你准备好谈谈《华尔街日报》了吗？

sentences.en: I feel like we're almost there anyway.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们反正也快聊到了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: When did you know that this was going to be a thing?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候知道这要变成一件大事的？

sentences.en: Like, as it was happening, it went really faSt.
sentences.zh: 事情发生的时候，进展得非常快。

sentences.en: I think just like two days before I heard about that whole thing and it was so...
sentences.zh: 我想大概就在我听到那整件事的两天前，而且太……

sentences.en: It did seem bizarre.
sentences.zh: 这确实显得很离奇。

sentences.en: I was like, well, I couldn't possibly understand why it was a thing even.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，根本无法理解这怎么就能成为一件事。

sentences.en: I didn't think it was going to be a big deal either.
sentences.zh: 我也没觉得会闹成什么大不了的事。

sentences.en: What was that day like for you?
sentences.zh: 对你来说那是怎样的一天？

sentences.en: Like, where were you?
sentences.zh: 比如，你在哪里？那是情人节。

sentences.en: It was on Valentine's Day.
sentences.zh: 那天是情人节。

sentences.en: Me and my girlfriend had rented this little cottage.
sentences.zh: 我和女朋友租了一间小屋。

sentences.en: And then, I mean, I can laugh about it now, I guess.
sentences.zh: 然后，我的意思是，现在我想起来还能笑得出来。

sentences.en: But it was crazy.
sentences.zh: 但当时太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Like, extremely stressful.
sentences.zh: 压力大得难以想象。

sentences.en: I didn't know what was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我根本不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: So you just spent the day on like calls with people?
sentences.zh: 所以你一整天都在跟别人打电话？

sentences.en: I spent the day being in this little cottage outside with no internet.
sentences.zh: 我一整天都待在外面那间没有互联网的小屋里。

sentences.en: And I told myself, okay, I should not check what is happening on Twitter right now.
sentences.zh: 我告诉自己，好了，现在千万不要去推特上看发生了什么。

sentences.en: And then I go on Twitter and then there's like J.K.
sentences.zh: 然后我一上推特，就看到J·K·

sentences.en: Rowling calling me a fasciSt.
sentences.zh: 罗琳叫我法西斯。

sentences.en: And I'm like, how is this happening?
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，这怎么可能？

sentences.en: This is crazy.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: And when you sort of were trying to figure out how to respond to that, were you torn between like, okay, on one hand, like, I probably should apologize for this.
sentences.zh: 当你试图弄清楚该如何回应时，你是不是在纠结：一方面，我可能应该为此道歉。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I did apologize in the video.
sentences.zh: 我在视频里也确实道歉了。

sentences.en: But also wanted to be like...
sentences.zh: 但同时也想……

sentences.en: I also wanted to set the record straight.
sentences.zh: 我也想澄清事实。

sentences.en: At least give my side of the story.
sentences.zh: 至少讲出我这边的故事。

sentences.en: And, you know, it was crazy because Wall Street Journal, they also came to my house to say, we want to help you, like, give you a full story again.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，太疯狂了，因为《华尔街日报》甚至还来我家说，我们想帮你，让你重新把完整的故事讲出来。

sentences.en: It just felt kind of crazy.
sentences.zh: 感觉简直不可思议。

sentences.en: Oh, so after the story published?
sentences.zh: 哦，是在报道发表之后？

sentences.en: After the story published, they came back, yeah.
sentences.zh: 报道发表之后，他们又来了，是的。

sentences.en: And you said?
sentences.zh: 然后你说了什么？

sentences.en: I said, well, I'll tell my story on my channel.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，我会在我自己的频道上讲述我的故事。

sentences.en: And that's kind of how I saw it.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是这么想的。

sentences.en: Was there a moment where you're like, fuck, like, what if they have a point?
sentences.zh: 有没有那么一刻，你想过：操，万一他们说得有道理呢？

sentences.en: And I got too edgy and, like, were there moments of...
sentences.zh: 我是不是真的太出格了？有没有过这种……

sentences.en: Yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 有的，当然有。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 肯定的。

sentences.en: It wouldn't have happened if I didn't push it too far, obviously.
sentences.zh: 如果不是我做得太过分，显然也不会发生这种事。

sentences.en: But I think the whole thing also that happened with Wall Street Journal made people really strongly want to support me.
sentences.zh: 但我认为《华尔街日报》这件事也让人们非常强烈地想要支持我。

sentences.en: People felt like it was unjust what happened.
sentences.zh: 大家觉得发生的事情很不公正。

sentences.en: And they wanted to support the channel even more for that.
sentences.zh: 因此他们更想要支持这个频道。

sentences.en: So I really felt like, well, maybe media doesn't want to write nice things about me.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的觉得，好吧，也许主流媒体不想写我的好话。

sentences.en: But at least I have the support from so many people that it felt like it doesn't matter to them.
sentences.zh: 但至少我有那么多人的支持，感觉这对他们来说根本不重要。

sentences.en: I don't really care if that's the case.
sentences.zh: 如果真是这样，我其实也无所谓。

sentences.en: I think also after the Wall Street Journal thing, I sort of got labeled as a bad person.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得在《华尔街日报》事件之后，我有点被贴上了坏人的标签。

sentences.en: And then that sort of line of word just kept going, I think.
sentences.zh: 然后这种舆论论调就一直延续下去了。

sentences.en: Is there one sort of piece of criticism that stands out that you sort of wrestled with more than others?
sentences.zh: 有没有哪一条批评让你格外在意，甚至比其他的更让你纠结？

sentences.en: I think the constant association with the alt-right and politics in general has been really frustrating.
sentences.zh: 我觉得持续将我和另类右翼以及整个政治圈子联系在一起，真的让人非常沮丧。

sentences.en: Because that whole world feels so far away from me.
sentences.zh: 因为那个世界离我太遥远了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that's frustrating.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这让人很泄气。

sentences.en: I think any label, you know, it seems pretty common to just label, throw labels around.
sentences.zh: 我觉得任何标签，你知道，到处给人贴标签、抛出各种帽子似乎很常见。

sentences.en: Oh, he's this, he's that.
sentences.zh: 哦，他这人就这样，他那人那样。

sentences.en: And be called things that you don't think you are at all.
sentences.zh: 被冠以那些你根本觉得自己不是的罪名。

sentences.en: What are your politics?
sentences.zh: 你的政治立场是什么？

sentences.en: I'm just curious.
sentences.zh: 我只是好奇。

sentences.en: How do you identify, what issues are you passionate about beyond YouTube?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么界定自己的，除了YouTube之外，你对什么议题充满热情？

sentences.en: I think I'm more apolitical than anything.
sentences.zh: 我觉得比起别的，我更倾向于去政治化。

sentences.en: But I'm probably somewhere in between.
sentences.zh: 但我可能处在中间的某个位置。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't really feel passionate about politics.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我对政治其实并没有什么热情。

sentences.en: I know that's a really lame reply.
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来是个很烂的回答。

sentences.en: I wish maybe I was, but I am not that invested.
sentences.zh: 也许我希望自己能热心一点，但我真的没投入那么多关注。

sentences.en: Are there any politicians who excite you?
sentences.zh: 有没有哪个政客能让你兴奋？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Like anywhere in the world?
sentences.zh: 世界上任何地方都没有吗？

sentences.en: I could not name one, no.
sentences.zh: 我一个名字也说不出来，没有。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Because, you know, there's this whole community of, like, conspiracy theorists and people who, like, think that you're secretly hiding.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，存在着一大群阴谋论者，还有人觉得你是在暗中隐藏什么。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Conspiracy theorists is the right word for it, yeah.
sentences.zh: 阴谋论者这个词用得很对，是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I was looking at, I have this whole log of, like, messages from these Discord servers for these all-right guys.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我当时在看，我保留了一整套来自那些另类右翼家伙的Discord服务器的消息记录。

sentences.en: And they're saying stuff like, you know.
sentences.zh: 他们在里面说那些话，你知道的。

sentences.en: Discord servers?
sentences.zh: Discord服务器？

sentences.en: Oh yeah, like, PewDiePie will red pill all his millennial and Gen Z subscribers.
sentences.zh: 哦，对啊，就好像PewDiePie会把他的所有千禧一代和Z世代订阅者都给“洗脑”一样。

sentences.en: It will be glorious.
sentences.zh: 那可太棒了。

sentences.en: I get the feeling that PewDiePie is far more red pill than he lets on.
sentences.zh: 我总觉得PewDiePie比他表现出来的要激进得多。

sentences.en: He'd be a great ally.
sentences.zh: 他会是个很棒的盟友。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: Like, what is that?
sentences.zh: 比如说，那到底是什么？

sentences.en: That's just conspiracy theory, mumbo-jumbo.
sentences.zh: 那不过是阴谋论和胡言乱语罢了。

sentences.en: I think it's really cringy as well.
sentences.zh: 我也觉得这真的很让人尴尬。

sentences.en: People try.
sentences.zh: 人们总是在尝试。

sentences.en: It's annoying as well.
sentences.zh: 这也挺烦人的。

sentences.en: People trying to have me as some sort of symbol.
sentences.zh: 有人想把我当成某种象征。

sentences.en: That doesn't apply.
sentences.zh: 这根本不适用。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报Dealbook的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市Dealbook峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域一些举足轻重的领袖，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的真实对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播精选采访，任何人都可以免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，你可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家能准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不想错过。

sentences.en: Let's talk about subscriber PewDiePie.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈订阅PewDiePie这个梗。

sentences.en: Like, when you started, did you have any idea that it would become this whole meme that would, like...
sentences.zh: 话说，当你刚开始的时候，你有没有想过这会变成一个梗，然后……

sentences.en: I think you know the answer.
sentences.zh: 我想你心里有答案。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I thought it would be a fun joke for, like, two weeks, maybe, max.
sentences.zh: 我以为这最多也就是个能火个两周的有趣笑话吧。

sentences.en: And that was, like, six months later.
sentences.zh: 而这已经是六个月之后了。

sentences.en: Were there parts of it that you thought were funny?
sentences.zh: 有没有哪些部分是你觉得有趣的？

sentences.en: Like, the printer hack, or, like...
sentences.zh: 比如，那个打印机黑客事件，或者……

sentences.en: Yeah, I think a lot of it was really funny.
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得其中很多都挺搞笑的。

sentences.en: People, you know, putting up posters, putting up banners.
sentences.zh: 大家到处贴海报、挂横幅。

sentences.en: And, yeah, the printer hack was kind of pushing it, but it was still pretty funny.
sentences.zh: 然后，是的，打印机黑客那次有点过分了，但还是挺搞笑的。

sentences.en: No one was hurt by it, at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 至少没有人因此受伤。

sentences.en: So, Kevin, the timing of all this is that you met Felix just weeks after the shooting at Christchurch.
sentences.zh: 所以，凯文，这一切的时间点是，你采访菲利克斯正是在基督城枪击案发生几周后。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And not only was this his first interview with the mainstream media in years, but it was also the first time that anyone had really gotten to ask him about the attack.
sentences.zh: 这不仅是他多年来首次接受主流媒体采访，也是第一次有人真正有机会就这场袭击向他提问。

sentences.en: Walk me through that day and, like, where you were when you heard that this had happened.
sentences.zh: 带我回顾一下那一天，比如，当你听到这件事发生时你在哪里。

sentences.en: And, yeah, I mean, it was, like, four in the morning.
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，当时大概是凌晨四点。

sentences.en: I rarely checked my phone at that time, but I had got a bunch of messages, and I was, like, barely conscious.
sentences.zh: 我平时那个时间很少看手机，但我收到了好多消息，当时脑子还不太清醒。

sentences.en: And then, obviously, I saw what had happened, and just this pit in my stomach.
sentences.zh: 然后很显然，我看到了发生了什么，胃里顿时一阵翻江倒海。

sentences.en: It was just awful to hear about, that someone would go so far.
sentences.zh: 听到这种事，听到有人竟然能做出这种地步，真的太可怕了。

sentences.en: What were some of the messages you got at 4 a.m.?
sentences.zh: 你凌晨4点收到的都是些什么消息？

sentences.en: It was a big mix of, fuck PewDiePie, now he's really gone too far.
sentences.zh: 各种各样的都有，比如去他的PewDiePie，他这次真的太过分了。

sentences.en: We need to shut him down.
sentences.zh: 我们得让他停播。

sentences.en: It just is awful, like...
sentences.zh: 这简直太糟糕了，比如……

sentences.en: And even people saying, you know, I don't think he's responsible, but blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, even though it's, like, it really, really hurts.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有人说，你知道的，我觉得这不怪他，但巴拉巴拉巴拉，尽管这听起来真的很伤人。

sentences.en: It was a fucked up day.
sentences.zh: 那真是糟糕透顶的一天。

sentences.en: It was a fucked up week.
sentences.zh: 那是糟糕透顶的一周。

sentences.en: It's been a fucked up month.
sentences.zh: 那也是糟糕透顶的一个月。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I mean, fuck, I feel bad even, like, oh, it's so bad for me that he used my name, and it's, like, people really affected by it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，操，我甚至连这种感觉都很糟糕，哦，他用了我的名字对我的影响太坏了，而且你知道，真正受影响的人……

sentences.en: But it felt like I was dragged into, again, like, this whole sphere of politics.
sentences.zh: 但我感觉自己又被卷入了政治这个大染缸里。

sentences.en: Do you feel, like, the responsibility that you have?
sentences.zh: 你觉得自己肩负着某种责任吗？

sentences.en: Because, you know, so many of your fans are young, and they're so passionate, and whatever.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道，你的很多粉丝都很年轻，而且他们充满热情，诸如此类的。

sentences.en: Like, do you feel, like, you've sort of gained a new, I guess, responsibility or ability to, like, shape the way those people see the world?
sentences.zh: 比如，你觉得自己是不是获得了一种新的、我猜可以说是责任或能力，去塑造这些人看世界的方式？

sentences.en: Yeah, obviously, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，很显然，是的。

sentences.en: It is a lot of responsibility.
sentences.zh: 这确实是很大的责任。

sentences.en: What do you think the responsibility is?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这个责任是什么？

sentences.en: Well, who, I don't know exactly what I would say, but, you know, having such a large audience, obviously, it is a responsibility.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谁，我不知道具体该怎么说，但你知道，拥有这么庞大的受众，这显然是一份责任。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I stress out about publishing stuff in the New York Times, and we have 4 million subscribers.
sentences.zh: 对，我是说，我在《纽约时报》发文章也会感到压力山大，而我们有400万订阅者。

sentences.en: You only have 4 million?
sentences.zh: 你们只有400万？

sentences.en: I know, it's pretty bad, right?
sentences.zh: 我知道，这挺惨的对吧？

sentences.en: It's true.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: So, one fallout, one piece of fallout from this Wall Street Journal thing, and then some of the other stuff, and then this New Zealand thing.
sentences.zh: 所以，其中一个余波，华尔街日报事件带来的余波之一，还有其他的一些事情，以及新西兰这件事。

sentences.en: Like, there are a lot of people who don't follow you, but who hear your name and think, oh, that guy's problematic, or he's a neo-Nazi, or he's all right.
sentences.zh: 比如，有很多人并不关注你，但他们听到你的名字就会想，哦，这家伙很有争议，或者他是个新纳粹，或者他挺正常的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Like, how does that affect you?
sentences.zh: 这会对你产生什么影响？

sentences.en: It is obviously tiresome to be associated with something that you're not.
sentences.zh: 和一个本不属于你的标签扯上关系，这显然是很让人厌烦的。

sentences.en: It's a lot more than I think I signed up for.
sentences.zh: 这远超出了我当初入行时的预期。

sentences.en: I don't want it to seem like I'm completely innocent either, and I've just done nothing wrong, and I've just been targeted, and I don't think that's the case either.
sentences.zh: 我也不想让自己显得完全无辜，好像我什么都没做错只是成了众矢之的，我不觉得是这样。

sentences.en: But it does feel pretty unfair.
sentences.zh: 但这也确实让人觉得很不公平。

sentences.en: I know also how people's minds kind of shift toward certain things, and I hope that within the next maybe year or two, people will have their mind changed.
sentences.zh: 我也知道人们的观念是如何朝着某些方向转变的，我希望在未来一两年内，人们的观念会有所改变。

sentences.en: That's usually how long it takes for people.
sentences.zh: 这通常就是人们转变观念所需的时间。

sentences.en: Because your videos will change?
sentences.zh: 因为你的视频会发生改变？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, I think so.
sentences.zh: 对，对，我想是的。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: What's your message to those people?
sentences.zh: 你对这些人有什么想说的？

sentences.en: If you could, like, shout something from the rooftops and have everyone hear it.
sentences.zh: 如果你可以从屋顶上大喊些什么，让所有人都听到的话。

sentences.en: Just click on the latest video I upload, and it's literally just me laughing at memes.
sentences.zh: 那就点开我上传的最新视频吧，里面真的就只是我在看梗笑而已。

sentences.en: I don't really know.
sentences.zh: 我其实也不知道。

sentences.en: So it's literally just, like, watch my stuff, and you'll get it.
sentences.zh: 所以真的就是，看看我的视频，你就懂了。

sentences.en: But a lot of people are not going to watch your stuff, right?
sentences.zh: 但很多人根本不会去看你的视频，对吧？

sentences.en: That's the problem.
sentences.zh: 这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: They're going to see these headlines.
sentences.zh: 他们只会看到这些头条新闻。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, do you feel like you can do anything to set the record straight at this point, or have you done pretty much all you can do?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你觉得你现在还能做点什么来澄清事实，还是说你已经能做的不妨都做了？

sentences.en: I can definitely set the record straight more, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我绝对可以做更多的事情来澄清事实，是的。

sentences.en: What would that look like?
sentences.zh: 那会是怎样的呢？

sentences.en: I don't know yet.
sentences.zh: 我还不知道。

sentences.en: I think it's step by step.
sentences.zh: 我觉得得一步一步来。

sentences.en: I don't think anyone's going to change their mind over one thing.
sentences.zh: 我不觉得仅凭一件事就能改变任何人的想法。

sentences.en: I need to keep pointing it out.
sentences.zh: 我需要不断地指出来。

sentences.en: I think hopefully conversations like this helps as well.
sentences.zh: 我也希望这样的对话能有所帮助。

sentences.en: I see it as a build block.
sentences.zh: 我把它看作是一个积木。

sentences.en: I am sort of curious about, like, your relationship with the media.
sentences.zh: 我其实挺好奇你和媒体之间的关系的。

sentences.en: I mean, that's sort of a consistent theme of the past couple of years for you, is that you feel like the media has bad intentions when it comes to covering you,
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是你过去几年经历中贯穿始终的一个主题，那就是你觉得媒体在报道你时抱有恶意，

sentences.en: that there's publications that consistently get things wrong.
sentences.zh: 有些出版物总是一再把事情搞错。

sentences.en: Like, how have the past couple of years shaped or changed your views on the media?
sentences.zh: 过去几年是怎样塑造或改变你对媒体的看法的？

sentences.en: Well, a lot of times me calling out is when things have been said that I felt like were either one-sided or flipped in a way that wasn't really fair.
sentences.zh: 嗯，很多时候我发声抗议，是因为有些言论让我觉得要么极其偏颇，要么被扭曲得极其不公平。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, I should at least defend myself if those things happen.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，如果这种事情发生，我至少应该为自己辩护。

sentences.en: It's very frustrating to see certain things published about you that you feel like that is not what is true about me at all.
sentences.zh: 看到关于你的某些报道，让你觉得这完全不是真实的你，这让人感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: I mean, the hostility toward the media on, not just your channel, but, like, the subreddit.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这种对媒体的敌意不仅存在于你的频道，还存在于红迪板块（subreddit）上。

sentences.en: And, like, I just looked through that stuff and I'm like, dear God, these people are, like, never going to believe anything.
sentences.zh: 而且，我刚浏览了那些内容，心想，天哪，这些人简直是什么都不会相信了。

sentences.en: Like, it's like, these are people who just reflexively distrust everything we do.
sentences.zh: 就好像，这些人对我们所做的一切都抱有一种条件反射般的不信任。

sentences.en: I mean, I think it's because people who watch me know who I am and then they see me in this article.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得这是因为看我视频的人了解我是谁，然后他们在这篇报道中看到了我。

sentences.en: That is so different.
sentences.zh: 那是如此的不同。

sentences.en: And obviously, they're not going to, they feel like it's unfair or that it's not correct.
sentences.zh: 很显然，他们不会买账，他们会觉得这很不公平，或者说这是不对的。

sentences.en: I don't really know where the line is drawn of who controls that, you know.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道谁来掌控这一切，这条界限究竟划在哪里。

sentences.en: But I think it's getting a bit tiring as well.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得这也开始变得有点累人了。

sentences.en: I'm not really interested in having some sort of, I don't know, like, the media sort of approach to things.
sentences.zh: 我对采用某种，我不知道，类似媒体那种方式来处理事情其实并不感兴趣。

sentences.en: That's not my intention.
sentences.zh: 那不是我的初衷。

sentences.en: And I think, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我想，是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I hope at least I've grown a little bit to see past that even if an article isn't perfect, then it doesn't have to be a whole thing about it.
sentences.zh: 我希望至少自己已经成长了一点，能够看淡那些事，即使一篇文章不够完美，也没必要小题大做。

sentences.en: I mean, let's be clear, you've made a lot of videos about the media.
sentences.zh: 我是说，有一点我们要搞清楚，你做过很多关于媒体的视频。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I think my, I know it's like.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我的，我知道就像是。

sentences.en: It seems to be like your primary enemy sometimes.
sentences.zh: 有时候这看起来就像是你的头号敌人。

sentences.en: Let's put that out there.
sentences.zh: 我们把它挑明了吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I don't want it to seem like I'm, oh, I'm sitting down with the media now.
sentences.zh: 我不想让人觉得我是，哦，我现在坐下来接受媒体采访了。

sentences.en: So now I'm going to be like cuddly, wuddly or like.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我要变得人畜无害或者像什么一样。

sentences.en: I mean, that is a little bit how it feels.
sentences.zh: 我是说，感觉确实有点那么回事。

sentences.en: I don't know why.
sentences.zh: 我也不知道为什么。

sentences.en: That's good then.
sentences.zh: 那这样挺好的。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't want to be too hostile, but I also feel like my, genuinely, like my opinion about a lot of it has changed over the years.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我不想表现得太有敌意，但我也觉得，多年来我对很多事情的看法确实发生了真正的改变。

sentences.en: I think going through all these kinds of controversies constantly.
sentences.zh: 我想这正是因为不断经历所有这些争议。

sentences.en: And obviously when I feel the need I need to defend myself, I do.
sentences.zh: 很显然，当我觉得有必要为自己辩护时，我就会去做。

sentences.en: But I also think I'm getting to a point where I don't think it's going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 但我也觉得我正在走到这样一个地步：我觉得这样做无济于事。

sentences.en: And Kevin, what did you leave this interview thinking about, especially around this question of why he finally talked with you?
sentences.zh: 凯文，这次采访结束后你有什么感想，尤其是关于他为什么最终选择接受你采访这个问题？

sentences.en: I mean, obviously, like he doesn't need me to get a message out to the public.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，很显然，他根本不需要我来向公众传达信息。

sentences.en: Like he has millions more subscribers than the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 就像他的订阅者比《纽约时报》多出几百万一样。

sentences.en: But by talking to me when he did, it almost felt like he was proposing a truce.
sentences.zh: 但他在那个时间点接受我的采访，感觉就像是在提议停战。

sentences.en: He was saying that like that era of my career is over and I'm going to change.
sentences.zh: 他是在说，我职业生涯的那一个时代已经结束了，我要做出改变。

sentences.en: I wanted to talk seriously and honestly for a moment about my thoughts on what's been going on for the past couple of months.
sentences.zh: 我想认真诚恳地花点时间谈谈我对过去几个月所发生事情的想法。

sentences.en: And hopefully you can get a better understanding.
sentences.zh: 希望你们能有更深入的了解。

sentences.en: And a few days after our interview.
sentences.zh: 就在我们采访几天后。

sentences.en: Something happened that I don't think anyone would have predicted.
sentences.zh: 发生了一件我想谁也预料不到的事。

sentences.en: The Christchurch shooter said, subscribe to PewDiePie.
sentences.zh: 基督城枪手说，去订阅PewDiePie。

sentences.en: Felix posted a new video.
sentences.zh: 菲利克斯发布了一个新视频。

sentences.en: I think it's time to end the subscribe to PewDiePie movement or meme.
sentences.zh: 我觉得是时候结束“订阅PewDiePie”这个运动或梗了。

sentences.en: Where he directly asked his fans to end the subscribe to PewDiePie meme.
sentences.zh: 他在视频中直接请求他的粉丝们停止“订阅PewDiePie”这个梗。

sentences.en: To have my name associated with something so unspeakably vile has affected me in more ways than I let shown.
sentences.zh: 我的名字竟然和如此难以言喻的邪恶事物联系在一起，这对我造成的打击远比我表现出来的要深远。

sentences.en: I just didn't want to address it right away.
sentences.zh: 我只是不想马上回应这件事。

sentences.en: And I didn't want to give the terrorists any more attention.
sentences.zh: 我不想给恐怖分子更多的关注。

sentences.en: I didn't want to make it about me.
sentences.zh: 我不想把焦点扯到自己身上。

sentences.en: Because I don't think it has anything to do with me.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得这跟我没有任何关系。

sentences.en: Not long after that.
sentences.zh: 没过多久。

sentences.en: Nine years ago, I uploaded my first video onto YouTube.
sentences.zh: 九年前，我把我的第一段视频上传到了YouTube。

sentences.en: This is what that video looked like.
sentences.zh: 这就是当年那段视频的样子。

sentences.en: Felix hit 100 million subscribers.
sentences.zh: Felix的订阅数达到了1亿。

sentences.en: I won't bore you with every step of the way of the journey.
sentences.zh: 我不会用这一路走来的每一个细节来烦大家。

sentences.en: It's been long.
sentences.zh: 这段路很长。

sentences.en: It had its ups and downs.
sentences.zh: 它有高潮也有低谷。

sentences.en: And to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 为了庆祝。

sentences.en: I made a lot of mistakes on the way, but I've grown.
sentences.zh: 我在路上犯了很多错误，但我成长了。

sentences.en: He reflected on how he got there.
sentences.zh: 他反思了自己是如何走到这一步的。

sentences.en: And I feel like I've finally come in terms with the responsibility I have as a creator.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得我终于坦然接受了作为一名创作者所肩负的责任。

sentences.en: About 100 million subs too late, but you know.
sentences.zh: 虽然晚了1亿订阅，但你们懂的。

sentences.en: But the channel's done a lot of good too.
sentences.zh: 不过这个频道也做了很多好事。

sentences.en: And also pledged to give a $50,000 donation to the Anti-Defamation League.
sentences.zh: 并且还承诺向反诽谤联盟捐赠5万美元。

sentences.en: Which is one of the organizations that had criticized him for making Hitler Nazi jokes.
sentences.zh: 该组织曾因他开有关希特勒和纳粹的玩笑而批评过他。

sentences.en: We did it!
sentences.zh: 我们成功了！

sentences.en: I want to thank all the people I work with over the past couple years.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢过去几年里与我合作的所有人。

sentences.en: But most importantly, I want to thank the bros.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，我要感谢兄弟们。

sentences.en: And yet again, it sparked a controversy.
sentences.zh: 然而这再次引发了一场争议。

sentences.en: Stop!
sentences.zh: 停下！

sentences.en: I just wanted to interrupt this video because I need to make an announcement.
sentences.zh: 我只是想打断这段视频，因为我需要宣布一件事情。

sentences.en: Did you guys see the video I made where I celebrated 100 million subscribers?
sentences.zh: 大家看了我庆祝1亿订阅的那个视频吗？

sentences.en: It was the video I was really excited.
sentences.zh: 那是让我非常兴奋的视频。

sentences.en: But this time, it wasn't the mainstream media coming after him.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，来找他麻烦的不是主流媒体。

sentences.en: I made the mistake of picking a charity that I was advised.
sentences.zh: 我犯了一个错误，选了一个别人建议的慈善机构。

sentences.en: Instead of picking a charity that I'm personally passionate about.
sentences.zh: 而不是选择一个我个人真正热爱的慈善机构。

sentences.en: Which is 100% my fault.
sentences.zh: 这100%是我的错。

sentences.en: It was the internet.
sentences.zh: 是互联网。

sentences.en: The whole internet just didn't believe it.
sentences.zh: 整个互联网根本不相信这件事。

sentences.en: Like, why is he donating to this charity?
sentences.zh: 比如，他为什么给这个慈善机构捐款？

sentences.en: Look at his face.
sentences.zh: 看他的表情。

sentences.en: Full conspiracy mode.
sentences.zh: 完全进入了阴谋论模式。

sentences.en: Some of his fans claimed that the Anti-Defamation League was too partisan.
sentences.zh: 他的一些粉丝声称反诽谤联盟太有党派倾向了。

sentences.en: Websites and comment sections filled up with all these conspiracy theories.
sentences.zh: 各大网站和评论区充斥着各种阴谋论。

sentences.en: Saying like, PewDiePie is being blackmailed into this donation.
sentences.zh: 说什么PewDiePie是被勒索才进行这笔捐款的。

sentences.en: I'm sorry for all the confusion.
sentences.zh: 对于由此产生的所有混乱，我感到很抱歉。

sentences.en: And I'm sorry for messing this up.
sentences.zh: 我也很抱歉把事情搞砸了。

sentences.en: That's what I do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的作风。

sentences.en: So, he apologized.
sentences.zh: 于是，他道了歉。

sentences.en: And took back his $50,000 pledge.
sentences.zh: 并收回了那5万美元的捐款承诺。

sentences.en: Good one.
sentences.zh: 干得漂亮。

sentences.en: Here we go, guys.
sentences.zh: 我们走吧，伙计们。

sentences.en: Historical moment.
sentences.zh: 历史性的时刻。

sentences.en: My first video ever was a Minecraft video.
sentences.zh: 我历史上的第一个视频是一个《我的世界》视频。

sentences.en: And in the midst of all this, nearly a decade after it first brought him attention.
sentences.zh: 正当这一切发生之际，距离这款游戏最初给他带来关注已经过去了将近十年。

sentences.en: My God.
sentences.zh: 我的天呐。

sentences.en: After all these years.
sentences.zh: 历经这么多年。

sentences.en: Felix uploaded a video of himself playing Minecraft.
sentences.zh: Felix上传了一段自己玩《我的世界》的视频。

sentences.en: Is that a fucking horse?
sentences.zh: 那他妈是一匹马吗？

sentences.en: That's a freaking horse.
sentences.zh: 那真是一匹马。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，我的天呐。

sentences.en: There's horses in Minecraft.
sentences.zh: 《我的世界》里有马了。

sentences.en: Can I ride it?
sentences.zh: 我能骑它吗？

sentences.en: Look, it's a tiny horse.
sentences.zh: 看，这是一匹小马。

sentences.en: Hello, tiny horse.
sentences.zh: 你好，小马。

sentences.en: This is amazing.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: I love Minecraft.
sentences.zh: 我爱《我的世界》。

sentences.en: Have you ever wondered why we go to war?
sentences.zh: 你有没有想过我们为什么要打仗？

sentences.en: Or why you never seem to be able to get out of debt?
sentences.zh: 或者为什么你似乎永远摆脱不了债务？

sentences.en: Why there is poverty, division, and crime?
sentences.zh: 为什么会有贫困、分裂和犯罪？

sentences.en: What if I told you there was a reason for it all?
sentences.zh: 如果我告诉你这一切都是有原因的呢？

sentences.en: What if I told you it was done on purpose?
sentences.zh: 如果我告诉你这是故意的呢？

sentences.en: What if I told you that those who were corrupting the world, poisoning our food, and igniting conflict were themselves about to be permanently eradicated from the earth?
sentences.zh: 如果我告诉你那些腐蚀世界、毒害我们的食物、挑起冲突的人即将被永远从地球上清除呢？

sentences.en: You might think that an idealistic fantasy.
sentences.zh: 你可能会觉得那是一种理想主义的幻想。

sentences.en: Well, let me tell you a story.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我给你讲个故事。

sentences.en: To hear more, go to whatever app you're using to hear me right now.
sentences.zh: 想了解更多，请打开你现在收听我节目的任意应用。

sentences.en: Search for rabbit hole.
sentences.zh: 搜索rabbit hole。

sentences.en: Two words.
sentences.zh: 两个字。

sentences.en: And hit subscribe.
sentences.zh: 然后点击订阅。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了许多自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时又令人兴奋的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都会》节目中，我和萨拉·科尼格将带你了解那些试图维持影响力却在途中失去控制的人的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 都会。

sentences.zh: 在各大播客平台皆可收听。
